method: Exact normalized title and original PII match; read each full recovered abstract and make individual AI4S decisions. Preserve publisher wording and mathematical markup.
notes: Requeries recovered the missing full abstract before screening. No summary, introduction or keyword expansion was inserted. Empty following text in the boundary audit indicates the indexed result ended after the complete concluding abstract sentence; all such entries were read and checked. Index 49 was rechecked and the publisher abstract itself starts with 'In this paper'. Full publisher page bodies and unrelated results are not redistributed.
